claims.hypothesis: Is star formation in Sgr B2 extended beyond the N, M, S protoclusters?
claims.experiment: 3 mm ALMA mosaic, source catalog and classification
claims.result: 271 compact sources over ~12x3 pc, >half of new generation not in clusters
claims.finding: Sgr B2 is undergoing an extended star formation burst

evidence.quote: More than half of the currently forming generation of stars is not associated with any of the clusters but is instead part of the extended burst.

claims.hypothesis: Does Sgr B2 follow the local-cloud column density threshold for star formation?
claims.experiment: Compare source background column densities and YSO counts with Lada+2010
claims.result: All sources above ~1e23 cm-2 but much gas without YSOs; YSO count 3-6x below extrapolation
claims.finding: Higher threshold required in Sgr B2

evidence.quote: Any way we examine our data, it appears that a higher column density threshold for star formation is required in Sgr B2 than in local clouds.

claims.hypothesis: Do local-cloud Sigma*-Sigma_gas relations extrapolate to Sgr B2?
claims.result: alpha=2 relation inconsistent; linear alpha=1 consistent; local extrapolation exceeds data by >=50x
claims.finding: A volume-density threshold, higher in CMZ, may be needed

evidence.quote: While our data are clearly incompatible with the $\alpha=2$ relation, they are reasonably compatible with a linear $\alpha=1$ relation
